copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Webex 适配器及其注册测试从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/,追加自注册 import,安装固定版本依赖,再执行构建与注册测试;并引导你创建 Webex 机器人、把凭据写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Webex 渠道、或提到「加 Webex」时触发;创建机器人、填凭据、配 webhook 这几步需要你手动完成。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 渠道加进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑构建与测试

say.text: 重新跑一遍 Webex 的注册测试
say.note: 检查 barrel 导入和依赖是否漂移

say.text: Webex 收不到消息,帮我排查 webhook
say.note: 核对 webhook 地址、状态与签名密钥

howto.what_en: Copies the Webex adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends the self-registration import, installs the pinned package, builds and runs the test, then guides bot creation and .env credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Webex channel to NanoClaw or ask to add Webex; creating the bot, credentials and webhook are manual steps.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs build and test
Checks the barrel import and dependency

say_en.text: Webex isn't receiving messages, debug the webhook
say_en.note: Checks webhook target, status and secret
